snippet.title: Great Personality: Guardians
snippet.description:
Great Personality: Guardians will be available to downloaded for free begining Friday, January 24th, and can be found on our site: http://lightgreyartlab.com/

We're pleased to announce that Great Personality: Guardians is the first of four interactive dating-sim games we're releasing in conjunction with the Great Personality exhibition at Light Grey Art Lab.

And look out for the following three games coming soon! 

To learn more about the Great Personality project, visit: http://lightgreyartlab.com
